column1: # Upstream citations the audit skill's checklist and references depend on.
# One row per <page slug><TAB><literal text the page must carry>. The page is
# as their `### `heading` row on settings-reference; prose claims are cited by
# a short literal span. check-doc-citations.sh greps each row and fails when a
# fetched page no longer carries its span, which is the moment the checklist
# row that cites it has to be re-derived.

column2: The space before a trailing `*` is part of the rule
